content.short: Enkrypt is a non-custodial open-source wallet designed for the multichain future.
content.description: Enkrypt is a browser extension wallet designed for easy, secure access to Web3 in a multichain future. It is open-source and non-custodial, and it tracks no data, giving you full control of your assets. Interact with Ethereum, Bitcoin, and other networks directly in your browser with a powerful, user-friendly wallet built for multichain asset management. As you connect to more chains, Enkrypt aims to provide a streamlined, private, and flexible experience for handling cross-chain activity from a single extension.
content.meta: Enkrypt is a non-custodial open-source wallet built for multichain asset management. Discover Enkrypt and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
